children: Australian stocks edged up 14 points, or 0.2%, to 8,747 in early Friday trade, extending gains for a third straight session after Wall Street rebounded overnight as easing oil prices and softer Treasury yields helped calm nerves after the Fed’s rate-hike shock.
Tech, non-energy minerals, and consumer durables drove the gains, though losses in healthcare, energy minerals, and retail trade capped the upside.
Gold miners advanced, with Northern Star Resources up 2.7% and Evolution Mining rising 3.0%, while Lynas Rare Earths, Perseus Mining, and South32 each added over 2%.

For the week, the domestic market was little changed, stabilizing after recent declines as traders weighed remarks before parliament from RBA Governor Michele Bullock, who warned that upside inflation risks are emerging amid surging global energy costs from the prolonged Middle East conflict, compounded by pressures from the AI data-centre boom and extreme weather.

title: Australia Shares Inch Higher,  Weekly Picture Muted
